The gospel was bearing fruit and growing among them. Where do you see the gospel bearing fruit?
Paul prays they would walk worthy of the Lord, bearing fruit and strengthened with power. Which part do you need?
Christ is the image of the invisible God, and in him all things hold together. What does this show about who Jesus is?
Once alienated, you are now reconciled to God through Christ's death. What does it mean to be reconciled?
Christ in you is the hope of glory. What does that mean for your daily life?
In Christ are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge. Where do you look for wisdom?
"Walk in him, rooted and built up in him... abounding in thanksgiving." How can you stay rooted in Christ?
Christ cancelled the record of debt by nailing it to the cross. What does this mean for you?
Paul warns that rules can look wise but cannot stop the flesh. Why can't rules alone change us?
"Set your minds on things that are above." What would that change about your day?
Paul says to put to death what is earthly. What needs to go in your life?
"Put on compassionate hearts, kindness, humility, meekness, and patience." Which do you need to put on today?
Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, and do everything in Jesus' name. How can you do today's tasks in his name?
"Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord." How would this change your work?
"Continue steadfastly in prayer, being watchful in it with thanksgiving." How is your prayer life?
"Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt." How could your words be more gracious?
Paul names many co-workers and friends. Who are the people you serve God alongside?
Epaphras was always struggling for them in his prayers. Who could you pray for like this?
